violations.text: Food contact surfaces of the ice machine were observed with an accumulation of bio-film. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Ice machine turned off and to be fully washed, rinsed, and sanitized before use. Staff purchased bags of ice at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/05/2026

Sauce, which was prepared in advance, was not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours. Sauce which was prepared yesterday was observed at 45 degrees. Product was disposed of. Proper cooling procedures reviewed with PIC. Cooling chart provided. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/05/2026

Chlorine sanitizer solution was observed in excess of 200 parts per million (ppm). A chlorine sanitizer solution applied to food contact surfaces must be between 50-100 ppm. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/05/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Two containers of onion soup was placed hot(133-144) in the walk-in refrigerator in covered plastic containers greater than four inches deep. PIC relocated items to ice bath and uncovered containers. Cooling guidance provided. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/05/2026
Containers of dry ingredients were observed stored on the floor in the ice machine/storage closet area. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 11/05/2026

The floors in the storage closet has a small accumulation of old rodent droppings. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 11/05/2026
The date when the last shellfish was used from the bag must be noted on the shellfish tag. New Violation. Correct By: 03/28/2024

Chlorine sanitizer solution was observed in excess of 200 parts per million (ppm). A chlorine sanitizer solution applied to food contact surfaces must be between 50-100 ppm. Bottle was corrected to adequate ppm. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 03/28/2024

The floor and ledges on the wall in the basement area has an accumulation of old rodent droppings. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 03/28/2024
